situations.headline: Rights & Issues Investment Trust: Jupiter manager departures trigger board review of management arrangements

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Rights & Issues Investment Trust: Jupiter manager departures trigger board review of management arrangements (interest 6, risk 4)

thesis.text: RIII faces a governance inflection point following the announced departure of its long-standing Jupiter managers in early 2027, prompting a formal board review of asset management arrangements; outcome (new manager, fee changes, or strategic alternatives) is the key catalyst to monitor, while ongoing buybacks suggest management continues to support the share price/discount in the interim.
